rows.question: Stand-Up India kis ke liye hai?
rows.answer: Stand-Up India SC, ST aur mahila udyamiyon ke liye hai jo naya vyapaar shuru karna chahte hain. Apply karne ke liye apne bank branch ya standupmitra.in par jaa kar loan ke liye apply karein. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Mujhe kaunsi yojana milegi?
rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aapki umar kitni hai?

rows.question: Main kisan hoon, mujhe kaunsi yojana milegi?
rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aapki umar kitni hai?

rows.question: Meri umar 30 hai, kaunsi yojana mere liye sahi hai?
rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aap kya kaam karte hain (kisan, student, dukaandar, mazdoor, ...)?

rows.question: Garib hoon, sarkar se kya madad milegi, kaunsi yojana milegi?
rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aapki umar kitni hai?
